@echo off
echo Restoring Windows Notifications and Action Center...
sc config WpnService start=auto >nul 2>&1
Reg.exe delete "HKLM\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Services\WpnUserService" /v "Start" /f >nul 2>&1
Reg.exe delete "HKCU\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\PushNotifications" /v "ToastEnabled" /f >nul 2>&1
Reg.exe delete "HKCU\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\Explorer" /v "DisableNotificationCenter" /f >nul 2>&1
Reg.exe delete "HKLM\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\ImmersiveShell" /v "UseActionCenterExperience" /f >nul 2>&1
echo Notifications restored. Restart your PC.
pause
